pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-pigmented regions with high-frequency edge angularity. Individual patches exhibit a 'broken' or stellate geometry with sharp pixel gradients at the interface with lighter corridors. Spatial area is greater in the mid-flank, decreasing in size towards the posterior and limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a multi-nodal topological graph. Junctions are primarily trifurcated. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains narrow and consistent, creating a sharply defined grid between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the dorsal neck line. The silhouette consists of short, densely packed vertical hair clusters creating a jagged interface with the background.
